items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both checking the Set before either inserts the id, so both run the handler.
Gap 2 describes a signed body delivered with a different X-Event-Id header changing the dedup key so a duplicate is processed again.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so the refund is never recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
